mergedParams.userDescription: Blurry text gradually coming into sharp focus.

output.title: Blurry to Sharp Focus Text Animation

prompts.prompt: Create a cinematic focus pull effect where blurry text gradually sharpens like a camera lens finding focus. Think of this as a rack focus shot in video editing - the text starts completely out of focus (heavy blur) and smoothly transitions to crystal sharp clarity. The animation should feel organic and camera-like, with a slight overshoot at the end (going slightly too sharp then settling back) to mimic real lens behavior. Use a BaseLayout container with centered positioning and a TextAtom for the text content. Apply a generic keyframe effect that animates the blur filter from 8-10px down to 0px over 2-3 seconds with an ease-out curve. Add a subtle scale animation from 1.02 to 1.0 to enhance the focusing sensation, as if the text is settling into place as it sharpens. Consider adding a very slight brightness boost during the focus transition to simulate the increase in light transmission when focus is achieved.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with containerProps.className='flex items-center justify-center w-full h-full' containing a TextAtom. Effects: Use generic keyframe effect with AnimationRange[] to animate filter blur(10px) to blur(0px) over 0-100% range with ease-out easing. Add secondary effect for scale from 1.02 to 1.0. Optional brightness filter from 0.9 to 1.0. Timing: 2.5 second total duration, blur animation 0-90%, scale animation 0-100%. Performance: Use will-change: filter, transform on the TextAtom. GPU acceleration via transform: translateZ(0). Consider using internal effect preset for reusability across multiple text elements.

prompts.prompt: Design a depth-of-field text reveal where multiple layers of text at different blur levels create a parallax-like focus effect. Imagine editing a multi-layer composition where foreground, midground, and background text layers each come into focus sequentially, creating depth. Start with all text layers blurred at different intensities (background most blurred, foreground least). Animate each layer's focus independently with staggered timing, creating a wave of sharpness moving through the depth layers. Use nested BaseLayout components with absolute positioning for each text layer. Apply different initial blur values (12px, 8px, 4px) and animate them all to 0px with staggered start times. Add subtle opacity changes (0.7 to 1.0) to enhance the depth perception. Include slight position shifts (translateY) to create a floating-into-focus effect.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with containerProps.className='relative w-full h-full' containing 3 child BaseLayout components with containerProps.className='absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center' for each layer. Each contains a TextAtom with different z-index values. Effects: Layer 1 (back): blur 12px to 0px, opacity 0.6 to 1, translateY 10px to 0px. Layer 2 (mid): blur 8px to 0px, opacity 0.7 to 1, translateY 5px to 0px, delay 0.3s. Layer 3 (front): blur 4px to 0px, opacity 0.85 to 1, translateY 2px to 0px, delay 0.6s. All using ease-in-out easing. Performance: Composite layers using transform3d. Stagger animations to avoid simultaneous repaints.

prompts.prompt: Build a typewriter-style focus effect where each character comes into sharp focus sequentially from left to right, like a vintage typewriter mechanism engaging. This mimics the editorial technique of revealing text character by character but with focus instead of opacity. Split the text into individual character spans within a BaseLayout container. Each character starts heavily blurred and snaps into focus with a mechanical, stepped animation. Use a rapid succession timing (50-100ms between characters) to create the typewriter rhythm. Add a subtle shake effect to each character as it focuses, simulating the mechanical impact. Include a slight scale pop (0.8 to 1.1 to 1.0) for each character to enhance the mechanical feel. Consider adding a subtle text-shadow that appears with the focus to create depth.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with containerProps.className='flex flex-row items-center justify-center flex-wrap' containing multiple TextAtom components (one per character or word). Use childrenProps or repeatChildrenProps for consistent styling. Effects: Each TextAtom gets staggered effects - blur 15px to 0px with steps(1) easing for mechanical snap, scale 0.8 to 1.1 to 1.0 with spring easing, optional shake via translateX/Y random values. Text-shadow from none to 2px 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.3). Timing: Calculate delay based on index * 80ms. Total duration per character: 300ms. Performance: Use CSS containment on parent. Batch DOM updates. Consider using internal effect preset for character animation.

prompts.prompt: Create a dreamy gaussian blur dissolve where text transitions from an ethereal, dream-like blur to sharp reality. This effect should feel like waking up from a dream or emerging from underwater. Start with extreme blur (20-30px) combined with a slight glow effect and low opacity. Gradually reduce blur while simultaneously increasing opacity and reducing the glow intensity. Add a subtle breathing animation (scale pulsing) during the blur phase that gradually stabilizes as focus is achieved. Include color temperature shift - cooler tones when blurred (slight blue tint) transitioning to neutral when focused. Use a very slow, meditative timing (4-5 seconds) with a custom cubic-bezier curve that accelerates in the middle.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with containerProps.className='relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden' containing TextAtom with initial blur filter. Effects: Primary effect animates filter from blur(25px) brightness(1.2) hue-rotate(-10deg) to blur(0px) brightness(1) hue-rotate(0deg). Secondary effect for opacity 0.4 to 1.0. Breathing effect via scale oscillating between 0.98 and 1.02 for first 60% of animation. Glow via text-shadow animating from 0 0 30px rgba(100,150,255,0.5) to none. Timing: 4.5s total, cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94). Performance: Use transform: translateZ(0) for GPU acceleration. Reduce blur steps for mobile via CSS media queries.

prompts.prompt: Develop a split-screen focus wipe effect where text clarity sweeps across from one side like a cinematic focus transition. Imagine a focus puller manually adjusting lens focus creating a diagonal or curved wipe pattern. The text starts completely blurred, then a wave of sharpness moves across it from left to right (or any direction). Use CSS clip-path to create two versions of the same text - one blurred, one sharp - and animate the clip-path to reveal the sharp version progressively. Add a slight lens distortion effect at the transition edge using transform skew. Include subtle chromatic aberration (RGB channel splitting) at the blur boundary to simulate lens optics. The transition should feel smooth and optical, like a real camera focus pull.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with containerProps.className='relative w-full h-full' containing two absolutely positioned TextAtom components with identical text. Bottom layer has blur filter, top layer is sharp with animated clip-path. Effects: Bottom TextAtom: constant blur(12px). Top TextAtom: clip-path polygon animating from polygon(0 0, 0 0, 0 100%, 0 100%) to polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%). Optional skew transform at transition edge via transform: skewX() animating from -5deg to 0deg. Chromatic aberration via separate R/G/B text-shadows offset by 1-2px. Timing: 2s duration, ease-in-out. Performance: Use will-change: clip-path. GPU acceleration via transform-style: preserve-3d.

prompts.prompt: Design an audio-reactive focus pulse where text sharpness responds to music beats or audio intensity. The text continuously shifts between slightly blurred and perfectly sharp states, synchronized with audio analysis data. Use waveform effects to map audio intensity to blur amount - louder/more intense moments trigger sharper focus, quiet moments add blur. Create a living, breathing text effect that feels connected to the soundtrack. Add complementary scale and brightness variations that also respond to audio. Include a baseline blur animation that ensures the text never stays completely static. This creates an organic, music-video style effect where typography becomes part of the rhythm.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout containing TextAtom with waveform effects configuration. Effects: Use waveform effect with type='blur', sensitivity=0.8, threshold=0.3, minValue=0, maxValue=8 (blur in pixels). Secondary waveform effect for scale with minValue=0.98, maxValue=1.05. Baseline animation via generic effect: subtle blur oscillation 0-2px repeating. Optional brightness waveform reacting to treble frequencies. Audio: Fetch audio analysis via props.fetcher, use impactful beats for emphasis moments. Timing: Continuous effect matching audio duration via fitDurationTo. Performance: Throttle audio updates to 30fps. Use requestAnimationFrame for smooth transitions.

prompts.prompt: Build a tilt-shift miniature focus effect where text appears to be part of a miniature model with selective focus. Create a gradient blur that's strongest at the top and bottom, sharp in the middle, simulating tilt-shift photography. The focus area should animate from a thin horizontal band expanding outward to reveal the full text. Use multiple text layers with varying blur amounts positioned at different heights. Add subtle perspective transform to enhance the miniature illusion. Include depth-of-field color desaturation - blurred areas slightly desaturated, focused areas vibrant. The animation should feel like adjusting a tilt-shift lens, with smooth, photography-inspired timing.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with containerProps.className='relative w-full h-full' containing multiple TextAtom components at different y-positions. Use CSS mask-image with linear-gradient for blur zones. Effects: Top/bottom TextAtoms: blur 10px to 3px, opacity 0.6 to 0.9, saturate(0.7). Middle TextAtom: blur 0px constant, scale 1.0 to 1.05 for emphasis. Mask animation: linear-gradient expanding from center 20% width to 100% width. Perspective: transform: perspective(1000px) rotateX(2deg) for depth. Timing: 3s duration, ease-in-out. Performance: Use backdrop-filter for efficient blur on modern browsers. Layer compositing via will-change: transform.

prompts.prompt: Create a glitch-focus effect where digital interference patterns give way to sharp text, like a corrupted video signal stabilizing. Start with heavy digital artifacts - blur combined with RGB channel separation, scan lines, and pixel displacement. Gradually reduce all distortion effects while the text comes into focus. Include intermittent glitch moments during the transition where focus briefly degrades then recovers. Add digital noise overlay that fades as focus improves. Use transform matrix distortions for authentic digital corruption. The effect should feel like recovering data or establishing a video connection, with technical, digital aesthetics.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with multiple layered TextAtom components for RGB channel splitting effect. Container uses containerProps.className='relative w-full h-full bg-black'. Effects: Primary blur animation 15px to 0px with periodic spikes back to 8px (glitch moments). RGB split via three TextAtom layers with translateX offsets animating from ±5px to 0px. Scan lines via repeating linear-gradient background animating opacity. Digital noise via CSS filter: contrast() and brightness() fluctuations. Transform matrix for skew/distort: matrix(1, 0.2, 0, 1, 0, 0) to matrix(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0). Timing: 2.5s total, with 3-4 glitch moments at calculated intervals. Performance: Use CSS animations for scan lines. Composite layers for RGB splits.

prompts.prompt: Develop a lens breathing focus effect that mimics professional cinema lenses where focus changes cause subtle size variations. As the text comes into focus, it should exhibit the characteristic 'breathing' - slight size changes that occur in real lenses during focus pulls. Start with heavy blur and slightly larger scale (1.08x), then animate to sharp focus with normal scale (1.0x). Add subtle barrel distortion at the edges during the blur phase. Include realistic bokeh simulation using CSS filters and shadows. The timing should match real-world focus pulling speeds - not too fast, with natural acceleration and deceleration. Add subtle vignetting that reduces as focus is achieved.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with containerProps.className='flex items-center justify-center w-full h-full' with overflow hidden. TextAtom centered with initial transform scale(1.08). Effects: Synchronized animations - blur 18px to 0px, scale 1.08 to 1.0, both with cubic-bezier(0.645, 0.045, 0.355, 1.0). Bokeh via multiple box-shadows animating from large soft shadows to crisp shadows. Vignette via radial-gradient overlay animating opacity. Barrel distortion via CSS filter: url(#distortion) with SVG filter. Timing: 2.8s duration matching cinema focus pull speed. Performance: GPU acceleration via transform3d. Precompose SVG filters.

prompts.prompt: Design a particle-based focus coalescence where blurry text particles converge and sharpen into readable text. Imagine text molecules floating in space, gradually coming together and focusing into crisp letterforms. Start with heavily blurred text that's also dispersed using particle-like displacement. Each part of the text has slight position offsets and rotation, creating a scattered effect. As focus increases, particles converge to their correct positions while blur reduces. Add subtle physics - slight bounce/overshoot when particles lock into place. Include particle trails or motion blur during movement. The effect should feel organic and physics-based, like magnetic particles aligning.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout container with multiple TextAtom components (word or character level) each with unique initial transforms. Use repeatChildrenProps for consistent base styling with index-based variations. Effects: Each particle animates blur 20px to 0px, translateX/Y from random offsets (±20px) to 0, rotate from random (±15deg) to 0deg, opacity 0.6 to 1.0. Use spring easing for natural physics. Motion blur via multiple text-shadows during movement phase. Particle trails using ::before/::after pseudo-elements with opacity fade. Timing: Staggered start times based on distance from center, 3s total duration. Performance: Use transform: translate3d() for GPU acceleration. Batch animations using CSS custom properties.
